description:
Meet Tomo, a baby chick who only speaks Japanese, and only as much as a real child its age.

At 1 year old Tomo says baby words like ワンワン and まんま. Show you understood by tapping the right picture, doing what Tomo asks (feed it, put it to bed, give it a hug), or picking what a word means. Every right answer helps Tomo grow: it hatches, learns two-word phrases, and by 3 starts asking you real questions.

The words come from research on the words Japanese children actually learn first, in the order they learn them, from baby talk up to six-year-old vocabulary. Words come back for review just before you'd forget them, so a few minutes a day adds up.

• Learn by understanding, not memorizing lists
• Tap any word for its reading and meaning, or open it in the iPhone's dictionary
• Home Screen widgets show Tomo and how many words are waiting
• On the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, Tomo calls you over when new words are ready
• Works offline. No account, no ads, no tracking: your progress stays on your iPhone.

Tomodachi is made by Zenbu Japanese.
promotionalText: Raise a baby chick that only speaks Japanese. Understand what Tomo says, and watch it grow from baby words to real conversations.
reviewNotes: No sign-in is needed. On launch Tomo asks a first word: tap the picture or meaning that matches what Tomo says. After the first launch, a Live Activity shows Tomo on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, and the Home Screen widget (small and medium) shows how many words are waiting. All learning content is bundled; the app makes no network requests.
